title: Optimize BM25 tokenizer cleanup
description: Avoid whole-input lowercase allocation and per-token replace allocation in BM25 tokenization.
convergence_criteria: tokenize scans raw whitespace tokens; punctuation/lowercase test exists; storage tests pass
hints: Keep old behavior: split on whitespace, remove non-alphanumeric chars inside each token, lowercase retained chars.
execution_directives: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --lib; cargo test --lib storage::inverted_index -- --nocapture; cargo test --lib storage::fusion -- --nocapture
